tier: EXACT-tier follow-through (refinement arm); grades nothing against T10a's band
directive: Sanaa H-3(a): T10a follow-through - the ceiling miss gets a refinement arm (discretization finding, cheap).
scope: the BOX only (1 x 1 x 0.5 m, six black patches). No spheres. The sphere NOT A RESULT rows are H-3(b), a different arm.

parent_published.note: T10a_RESULTS.md section 1, quoted for the record; every number the comparator grades is RE-MEASURED from the frozen T10a case trees at run time, never taken from this block.

R_x.role: arm R-x: fourth refinement level x beyond f, ratio 68/42 = 1.619048

R_q.role: arm R-q: f-level mesh, view-factor generator quadrature/method density raised (distTol 8 -> 80)

R_s.role: arm R-s: f-level mesh, solver tolerance / iteration-count bundle tightened; schemes untouched
R_s.the_one_change: fvSolution tolerances 1e-08 -> 1e-12, relTol 0.01/0.1 -> 0, nNonOrthogonalCorrectors 1 -> 3, controlDict endTime 20 -> 60 with writeInterval 15. fvSchemes byte-identical to B_f.

RX1.quantity: B1 ceiling q deviation from exact at level x, per cent
RX1.falsifier: deviation >= 0.1100 % (error not shrinking as registered) or <= 0.060 % (falling faster than the registered first-order-like family)

RX2.quantity: observed p of the m/f/x triple
RX2.falsifier: p > 2.00, or the triple is not CONVERGING (then NOT A RESULT, no verdict)

RX3.quantity: does the level-x GCI band cover the level-x error? ratio deviation/band
RX3.falsifier: deviation/band <= 1.0 (the band covers the error; the T10a/T9a band-smaller-than-error pattern does NOT persist)

RX5.quantity: sign-corrected Richardson from the m/f/x triple, per cent from exact
RX5.falsifier: > 0.100 % (worse than the c/m/f corrected Richardson T10a already recorded, 0.063 %)

RQ1.quantity: B1 ceiling q move from B_f, per cent of B_f
RQ1.falsifier: > 0.050 % (the ceiling miss IS a view-factor quadrature/method artefact)

RQ2.quantity: B0/B2/B3 moves from B_f, per cent, reported beside RQ1

RS1.quantity: B1 ceiling q move from B_f, per cent of B_f

RS2.quantity: identity test (Charter 2a): max |qr(R_s) - qr(B_f)| over every radiating face, W/m2
RS2.falsifier: any nonzero difference, given the precondition holds

instruments.gci_shared: analyse_t1c.gci, imported unedited (Fs 1.25, nominal r 1.6); the comparator refuses if Fs/r differ
instruments.gci_sign_corrected: NEW INSTRUMENT, this arm's own: richardson_corrected = f_f + (f_f - f_m)/(r^p - 1) (Roache). The shared gci() returns f_f + (f_m - f_f)/(r^p - 1), the sign defect T9a section 8.1 recorded and left unedited because it sits on no grading path. This arm reports both, side by side, and grades nothing on either.
instruments.flux_extraction: analyse_t10a.measure / row_value / iterative_convergence / planted_zero_control / mesh_patches, imported from the FROZEN analyse_t10a.py via a path shim (module HERE and REG['cases'] redirected); the frozen file is never edited
instruments.F_reader_lean: NEW INSTRUMENT: read_F_stream + radiosity_lean, a line-streaming replacement for the frozen read_F/dense_F/radiosity_on_F whose peak memory is one dense n x n matrix. Registered validation: on B_m, B_f, R_q and R_s the lean path must reproduce the frozen path's rowsum/reciprocity/python-vs-solver numbers to <= 1e-12 relative, or the comparator REFUSES.

cost.cap_rule: if the x level had been predicted above ~3 USD the ratio would have been cut to 1.26 (N=54); at 0.106 USD it was not
